name: BatchData API
tagline: Property owner and parcel enrichment API for real estate investors
description: BatchData provides APIs for skip-tracing-adjacent property owner identification and parcel enrichment. Investors and proptech apps use it to look up ownership, contact data, and property attributes from address or parcel inputs. Research base URL, auth, pricing, and examples from official docs before integrating.

auth.details: API key authentication; confirm header name and signup flow in current developer docs

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api.batchdata.com/api/v1/property/lookup" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"requests":[{"address":{"street":"1634 W Grovers Ave","city":"Phoenix","state":"AZ","zip":"85023"}}]}'

use_cases: enrich a property address with owner and parcel attributes
look up property ownership data for investor workflows
